```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(p8105.datasets)
data(nyc_airbnb)

library(tidyverse)
library(leaflet)

```

## some questions
* where are the most expensive airbnbs in nyc?
* which neighbourhood has the highest concentration of airbnbs?
* which one is the cheapest? 
* which airbnb hosts are the most/best reviewed?
* has the number increased or decreased over time? 
* do airbnbs affect rent in their neighborhoods?

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |>
  count(room_type, neighbourhood_group) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = room_type,
    values_from = n
  )
```

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |> 
  mutate(price_rank = min_rank(desc((price)))) |> 
  filter(price_rank < 10) |> view()
```


```{r}
nyc_airbnb |> 
  mutate(price_rank = min_rank(desc((price)))) |> 
  filter(price_rank < 10) |> view()
```

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |>
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan") |>
  filter(price < 500) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = neighbourhood, y = price)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```
## visualize price some more 
```{r}
nyc_airbnb |>
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan") |>
  filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt") |>
  filter(price < 500) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = lat, y = long, color = price)) +
  geom_point(alpha = .5)
```
make a leaflet map

```{r}
pal = colorNumeric(
  palette = "viridis",
  domain = 1:500
)
```


```{r}
nyc_airbnb |>
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan") |>
  filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt") |>
  filter(price < 500) |>
  sample_n(50) |>
  leaflet() |>
  addTiles() |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    ~lat, ~long, color = ~pal(stars), radius = .5)
```
